recipes.name: Easy Shrimp Vegetable Stir Fry
ingredients_raw: 1.5 pounds uncooked medium shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps.text: Stir rice and water together in a microwave-safe bowl. Cover and cook in the microwave on high until water is fully absorbed, about 8 minutes. Fluff with a fork; cover and set aside.
Whisk together soy sauce, water, honey, cider vinegar, and cornstarch in a small bowl; set sauce mixture aside.

Heat olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Stir in garlic and cook for 10 seconds. Add broccoli, carrots, onion, and black pepper; cook and stir until broccoli and carrots are tender, about 5 minutes. Stir in mushrooms and cook for 2 minutes. Remove vegetables from the skillet and set aside.

Return the skillet to heat and pour in sauce mixture; cook for 1 minute. Add shrimp and stir until shrimp are bright pink on the outside, meat is no longer transparent, and sauce thickens, about 3 minutes. Stir vegetables into the pan and serve over brown rice.

raw_recipe.headline: Easy Shrimp Vegetable Stir Fry
raw_recipe.description: Sweet caramelized shrimp stir-fry with veggies served over a fluffy bed of brown rice makes for an easy and crowd-pleasing meal!

review.reviewBody: This is a 5 star recipe when you add a teaspoon of ground ginger and a teaspoon of Chinese chili sauce to the sauce recipe. It give it just the right amount of kick!

I liked this a lot. I made some minor adjustments based on what I had, but it still turned out good. I followed the sauce recipe as written and added 1 tsp. of ginger. I used 2 packages of fresh cut up broccoli, carrots, and snow peas (stir fry blend) instead of the listed veggies. Also, I only had cooked shrimp, so I added those at the end just until they were hot. I normally am not this lazy but am in my 1st trimester of pregnancy and could probably fall asleep standing. ha! My husband & I enjoyed those cruncy chow mein noodles on top as well. My 21-month-old daughter gobbled up the shrimp and brown rice (veggies too crisp for her) with a side of peas. I'll make this again. I'd make it with chicken, too.

Quick and easy. Better than takeout. My family loved it! Definitely making again. Next time scallops. Added a very tiny pinch of ginger. Used Julianne carrots. Par boiled and then shocked the veggies ( red, yellow, orange bell pepper, broccoli) no onions just onion powder. Truly delicious. 😋

Great recipe. I added 1 tsp of red pepper flakes and 1-1/2 tsp ginger(fresh grated) with the garlic and onion sauté, then 1/2 tsp more to the sauce. Turned out excellent with just enough heat. Five stars with the small additions. :)

Great recipe! I cooked my rice in fat free chicken broth instead of water for more flavor and used more garlic than the recipe called for. My husband and 2 kids loved it! I cooked the broccoli first and then added to the mix. The broccoli would have been too crunchy for children to eat otherwise.

This is a good stir fry. I followed the suggestions to add ginger and a bit of chili sauce to some kick. I doubled the garlic and added a little zucchini I needed to use up. I used chicken stock instead of water. (In principle, when trying to achieve flavor in foods, I look for substitutes for water when recipes call for it.) The sauce is all-purpose for stir fry - would work well with chicken or beef, too.

I made this recipe twice so far. It was too thick and strong the first time I made it. Easily fixed it the second time by adding 1/2 to 2/3 cup water. My son- who is an excellent cook -thought it was just right the second time I made it. This is a keeper for me.

Cooked recipe this morning for dinner later this evening. Normally have Chinese on a Friday but wanted to save money. Gave a sample to older sister who said it was very good. 

Here are my adjustments:
omitted mushrooms and carrots, quartered onion instead of chopped,
sauteed onion and garlic together, added little water to sauce once thicken,
COOKED the broccoli the day before for less prep time,
use creole seasoning instead of black pepper,
added duck sauce that gave it the restaurant taste and look. 
 

Next time I will:
add more broccoli or decrease amount of shrimp for better balance,
decrease soy sauce and omit vinegar and will,
try frozen broccoli with chicken breast.

Recommendation: after you combine shrimp and broccoli, place on a low simmer for 5-10 minutes. You want the taste of the sauce throughout your broccoli florets. Absolutely tasty and restaurant quality!!!

Now, all I have to buy are the egg rolls and combination rice.

Made with the veggies I had on hand - broccoli, purple cauliflower, carrot, celery, green onion, and mushrooms. Veggies need to be cooked on higher heat until tender-crisp. Added a little red pepper flakes to veggies as they were cooking. Made sauce as written here. Served on white rice. It was perfect. Boyfriend said this might have been the best thing I ever cooked for him . Thanks for the recipe.
I modified the vegetables to zucchini, squash, and asparagus. It was perfect! I also used teriyaki/soy sauce mix. Will definitely make it again.

My husband loves this- told me not to loose the recipe. I substitute with veggies I have. Used celery, zucchini, snow peas, peppers and onion first time and sprinkled with cashews on top. Im also a big fan of coconut oil for frying. A great Paleo meal!
excellent - i used too much sauce so it was a little too sweet
This was excellent! Made it just like the recipe instructed and I will definitely make this again!
I made this a couple of times. Used much less hone 2nd time, as I do not like sweet dishes typically. Added some broth….great dish!
This was delish! Next time I’ll add water chestnuts
I used frozen stir-fry vegetables Leftover spaghetti noodles The sauce as written I'll definitely use this again
We love all stir fry recipes. So easy to make and healthy too!
This is a great meal. Easy to make and very tasty.

I made this as written mostly, douubled the sauce, added ginger and scrambled eggs, a lot of honey and yet wasn't sweet at all... Needed more flavor... Next time I will season everything as I go along... I also added bamboo shoots, water chestnuts and bean sprouts...
